current: Definition of Real Property Taxes.  As used herein, the term “Real Property Taxes” shall include any form of real estate tax or assessment, general, special, ordinary or extraordinary, and any license fee, commercial or rental tax, improvement bond or bonds, levy or tax (other than inheritance, personal income or estate taxes) imposed upon the Center by any authority having the direct or indirect power to tax including any city, state or federal government, or any school, agricultural, sanitary, fire, street, drainage, or other improvement district thereof, levied against any legal or equitable interest of Landlord in the Center, or any portion thereof, Landlord’s right to rent or other income therefrom, and/or Landlord’s business of leasing the Premises, together with any Sales Taxes (as defined below) imposed thereon.  The term Real Property Taxes shall also include any tax, fee, assessment, levy or charge or any increase therein, imposed by reason of events occurring or changes in applicable laws taking effect during the Lease, including, but not limited to, a direct or indirect change in the ownership of the Center, or any portion thereof or interest therein, the execution of this Lease, or any modification, amendment or transfer thereof, the construction of improvements upon the Land, any other type of tax, fee, excise or other imposition, however described, in lieu of, or as substitute for, or in addition to, the whole or any portion of Real Property Taxes, and whether or not contemplated by the parties hereto.  In calculating Real Property Taxes for any calendar year, the Real Property Taxes for any real estate tax year shall be included in the calculation of Real Property Taxes for such calendar year based upon the number of days which such calendar year and tax year have in common.  The term “Sales Taxes” means all sales, transaction and/or service taxes, levies, fees and/or other impositions which may, from time to time, be levied or imposed on the Rentals, or any portion thereof, any other item of rent under the Lease, or any item of goods, materials, labor or services to be provided under the Lease.  If any tax, fee, charge, excise or other imposition, however described, in lieu of, or as a substitute for, or in addition to, the whole or any portion of any Sales Taxes, then the same shall be included, whether or not now customary or in the contemplation of the parties on the date of this Lease, as Sales Taxes.  All Sales Taxes shall be due and payable in full at the same time such item of Base Rent, Monthly Direct Costs (and other rent as to which a Sales Tax is imposed) is due and payable to Landlord.
